hook.tts: Character dot A I's privacy policy says it doesn't sell users' data. Bankrupt now, it has set their chats for auction. Also: Telugu voice typing. And a fine for A I toys.
hook.tts_te: క్యారెక్టర్ అనే చాట్‌బాట్ యాప్, యూజర్ల డేటా అమ్మేది లేదని, పాలసీ లో రాసింది. ఇప్పుడు దివాలా తీసి, వాళ్ళ చాట్స్ వేలానికి పెట్టింది. ఇంకా: మన తెలుగుకి వాయిస్ టైపింగ్. మాట్లాడే టాయ్స్ మీద ఫైన్.

headline: Users' chats
set for auction
stories.dek: Minnesota & California attorneys general · Nov 23-24 · TechCrunch
stories.chapter: Character.AI's users' chats go to auction
stories.text: Its December 1 sale includes the chats of 21 million US accounts, 2.1 million of them under 18. 42 US attorneys general want it stopped. Or at least, kids' chats kept out.
tts: Its December first sale includes the chats of twenty-one million U S accounts, two point one million of them under eighteen.
Forty-two U S attorneys general want it stopped.
Or at least, kids' chats kept out.
tts_te: డిసెంబర్ ఫస్ట్ న అమ్మకం: అమెరికాలో రెండు కోట్ల పది లక్షల అకౌంట్ల చాట్స్; వాటిలో, పదిలో ఒకటి పద్దెనిమిదేళ్ల లోపు పిల్లలది.
నలభై రెండు మంది ప్రభుత్వ లాయర్లు, అమ్మకం ఆపమని కోర్టుకి వెళ్ళారు.
points: Character.AI, in Chapter 11 bankruptcy (filed in October, TechCrunch), is set to auction its assets on Dec 1, 2026: all chats with users' personal data, IP addresses and other metadata (Minnesota and California attorneys general)

Its privacy policy says "we do not sell personal information for monetary consideration"; more than 21 million US accounts, more than 2.1 million registered to minors; 42 attorneys general ask the court to deny the sale terms and the opening bidder's $350,000 break-up fee, and at a minimum to leave out kids' chats

headline: Grok sued over
sexual deepfakes
stories.dek: Oregon's Justice Department · Nov 22-23 · CNBC · claims, not a ruling
stories.chapter: Oregon and Virginia sue over Grok's sexual deepfakes
stories.text: Oregon and Virginia sued SpaceX, which now owns xAI and X, saying Grok made sexual fake images of real people, children included, while it was sold as safe. A watchdog study they cite counted about 3 million sexualised images posted on X in 11 days, from late December to early January, about 23,000 that appeared to show children. These are claims, not a ruling.
tts: Oregon and Virginia sued SpaceX, which now owns x A I and X, saying Grok made sexual fake images of real people, children included, while it was sold as safe.
A watchdog study they cite counted about three million sexualised images posted on X in eleven days, from late December to early January; about twenty-three thousand appeared to show children.
These are claims, not a ruling.
tts_te: అమెరికా లోని ఒరెగాన్, వర్జీనియా రాష్ట్రాలు, గ్రోక్ చాట్‌బాట్ యజమాని స్పేస్‌ఎక్స్ మీద కేసులు వేశాయి: పిల్లలతో సహా, నిజమైన మనుషుల అసభ్య ఫేక్ ఫోటోలు గ్రోక్ తయారు చేసిందని.
వాళ్ళు చూపిన ఒక స్టడీ ప్రకారం, డిసెంబర్ చివరి నుంచి జనవరి మొదటి వరకు, పదకొండు రోజుల్లో, దాదాపు ముప్పై లక్షల అసభ్య ఫోటోలు; వాటిలో దాదాపు ఇరవై మూడు వేలు పిల్లలవిగా కనిపించాయి.
points: Oregon's attorney general (filed Nov 22, announced Nov 23) and Virginia's sued SpaceX, which owns xAI, Grok and X: they say Grok was marketed as safe while a "spicy" mode made nude and sexualised images, including of children; they seek injunctions, civil penalties and profits

Figures from a Center for Countering Digital Hate study (Dec 29, 2025 - Jan 8, 2026) cited by Oregon: about 3 million sexualised images posted on X, about 23,000 that appeared to depict children; claims in a lawsuit, not findings

headline: Telugu voice typing
for Indian apps
stories.dek: Sarvam's blog · Mon, Nov 23 · price and test by Sarvam
stories.chapter: Sarvam Dictate: voice typing in 22 Indian languages
stories.text: India's Sarvam launched Dictate: speak English or one of 22 Indian languages, Telugu too, and it types it out. It's for app makers: 50 paise a minute, 30 rupees an hour, so expect it inside Indian apps. Sarvam says, in its own test, it needs fewer fixes than Gemini.
tts: India's Sarvam launched a tool called Dictate: speak English, or one of twenty-two Indian languages, Telugu too, and it types it out.
It's for app makers: fifty paise a minute, thirty rupees an hour, so expect it inside Indian apps.
Sarvam says, in its own test, it needs fewer fixes than Gemini.
tts_te: సర్వం అనే బెంగళూరు కంపెనీ, డిక్టేట్ అనే టూల్ తెచ్చింది: ఇంగ్లీష్ లో గానీ, తెలుగుతో సహా ఇరవై రెండు భారతీయ భాషల్లో గానీ మాట్లాడితే, టైప్ చేసి ఇస్తుంది.
ఇది యాప్స్ తయారు చేసేవాళ్ళ కోసం: నిమిషానికి యాభై పైసలు, గంట ఆడియోకి ముప్పై రూపాయలు; త్వరలో మన యాప్స్ లో కనిపించొచ్చు.
సర్వం సొంత టెస్ట్ లో, జెమిని కంటే తక్కువ తప్పులు అని చెప్తోంది.
points: Sarvam Dictate (Nov 23): an API for developers building dictation into their apps, English and 22 Indian languages (Telugu in its language menu), ₹0.50 per minute of audio (₹30 an hour); a playground at indus.sarvam.ai/api-playground/dictation
Sarvam's own test on dictations from its Kivi app: in Indian languages 8.8% of characters needed editing vs 15.5% for Gemini 3.5 Transcribe; in English 4.2% vs 7.0% (Sarvam's numbers)

headline: Talking AI toys:
a 5-year ban
stories.dek: New York governor's office · Mon, Nov 24
stories.chapter: New York bans AI chatbot toys for five years
stories.text: Finally: New York will ban toys with built-in AI chatbots, like talking teddies and dolls, for five years, starting in about three months. The fine: up to 15,000 dollars a day. Before you buy a talking toy, check if it goes online, and what it records.
tts: Finally: New York will ban toys with built-in A I chatbots, like talking teddies and dolls, for five years, starting in about three months.
The fine: up to fifteen thousand dollars a day.
Before you buy a talking toy, check if it goes online, and what it records.
tts_te: చివరగా: న్యూయార్క్, చాట్‌బాట్ ఉన్న టాయ్స్ ని, అంటే మాట్లాడే టెడ్డీలు, డాల్స్ లాంటివి, ఐదేళ్ల పాటు బ్యాన్ చేస్తోంది; దాదాపు మూడు నెలల్లో మొదలవుతుంది.
ఫైన్: రోజుకి పదిహేను వేల డాలర్ల వరకు, అంటే లక్షల్లో.
మాట్లాడే బొమ్మ కొనే ముందు, అది ఇంటర్నెట్ కి కనెక్ట్ అవుతుందా, ఏం రికార్డ్ చేస్తుందో, చూసుకోండి.
points: Governor Hochul signed (Nov 24) a five-year moratorium on making, distributing and selling toys with embedded or integrated AI chatbots, "such as talking stuffed animals, dolls and robots"; civil penalties up to $15,000 per day per violation, enforced by the Attorney General
It takes effect 90 days after signing, so not this holiday season; the release cites a watchdog's tests of AI toys marketed to children aged 3-12

outro.text: That's your AI week. Before you type something private into an AI app, remember: a privacy promise may not survive a bankruptcy. And subscribe to AI Maastaaru: AI Weekly, every Saturday.

ప్రతి శనివారం వీక్లీ న్యూస్ కోసం, ఈ ఛానెల్ ని సబ్‌స్క్రైబ్ చేసుకోండి.
